description: This Dart file defines the AuthProvider class, which manages authentication state within a Flutter application. It interacts with the AuthService to handle login, logout, registration, session initialization, and password reset functionalities, and exposes relevant state information for UI consumption.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider class that manages authentication state and provides authentication-related methods for a Flutter app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the authentication state by loading persisted tokens and user profile information.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with provided email and password, updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with provided name, email, and password, then updates the authentication state.

methods.name: requestPasswordReset
methods.description: Requests a password reset for the given email.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, resetting authentication state.
